newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's zinc output continues to grow. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's zinc output continues to grow. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]

text.p: Tunisia produced 29,700 tonnes of zinc during the first four months of 1996, up from 19,800 during the same period last year, official statistics showed.
Zinc production had sharply increased in 1995 with a 80,600 tonnes output against 26,600 tonnes in 1994, and 2,400 tonnes in 1993.

Tunisia also produced 3,500 tonnes of lead during the first four months of 1996 (Corrects from 1994), up from 3,200 tonnes during the same period in 1995. Total production of lead was 11,300 tonnes in 1995, up from 4,600 tonnes in 1994.

Zinc and lead are produced at the northwestern mining centre of Bougrine developed since 1994 by the Toronto-based Metall Mining Corp in which the German metal conglomerate Metallgesellschaft has a majority stake.
